name: contact-page
title: Contact page
description: Contact page with a heading, address, response time, and help link cards, and a validated contact form with a sent state.
usage: The site's contact page, the first section under the header. Copy comes through props (`title` and its blue `accent`, `email`, the response time and `helpLinks`); `onSubmit` receives the name, email, company, message and the hidden honeypot `website` once the name, a valid email and the message are filled, and shows the confirmation when it resolves or the thrown error's message when it rejects. `lockedEmail` fills and locks the email for a signed-in account. Field draws each error under its input.
avoid: Asterisks on the labels (the note under the form says what is required)
A second column of form fields beyond name and email
An arrow that moves when a help link is hovered
notes:
Clicking the address copies it: the copy icon cross-fades to a check in place (opacity and a slight scale, 200ms
ease-out) and the hint under it says so for two seconds. Nothing on the page moves on hover; links and the address only
change color.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
